from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Test parsing and syntax validation of ISO 8601 duration strings."""

    def test_missing_p_designator(self):
        """P designator is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "1D")

    def test_empty_duration(self):
        """Empty string is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "")

    def test_p_alone_no_components(self):
        """P without any components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_pt_alone_no_time_components(self):
        """PT without any time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT")

    def test_p_with_t_but_incomplete(self):
        """P1DT without time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT")

    def test_whitespace_not_allowed(self):
        """Whitespace anywhere in the string is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P 1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), " P1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D ")

    def test_lowercase_designators_invalid(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "p1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1d")

    def test_sign_on_component_invalid(self):
        """Sign on individual component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P-1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P+1D")

    def test_sign_at_start_plus(self):
        """Plus sign at start is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "+P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2)

    def test_sign_at_start_minus(self):
        """Minus sign at start is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 12, 31)

    def test_component_order_violation_md(self):
        """Components must be in order: Y, M, W, D, then T."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D1M")

    def test_component_order_violation_dw(self):
        """Components must be in order: Y, M, W, D, then T."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W1D")

    def test_component_order_violation_hm(self):
        """Components must be in order after T: H, M, S."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1M1H")

    def test_duplicate_year(self):
        """Year component cannot appear twice."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Y2Y")

    def test_duplicate_month(self):
        """Month component cannot appear twice."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_day(self):
        """Day component cannot appear twice."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D2D")

    def test_duplicate_hour(self):
        """Hour component cannot appear twice."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1H2H")

    def test_weeks_alone(self):
        """Weeks component can stand alone."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_weeks_with_days_invalid(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with other components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2W3D")

    def test_weeks_with_hours_invalid(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with time components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2WT1H")

    def test_weeks_with_months_invalid(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with other components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2W")

    def test_no_digits_in_component(self):
        """Component must have at least one digit."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PDT1H")

    def test_invalid_designator(self):
        """Invalid designators raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1X")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Z")

    def test_multiple_signs(self):
        """Multiple signs are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "--P1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "+-P1D")


class TestBasicComponents:
    """Test parsing of individual components."""

    def test_years_only(self):
        """Parse and apply years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45), "P2Y")
        assert result == datetime(2027, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45)

    def test_months_only(self):
        """Parse and apply months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 8, 15)

    def test_weeks_only(self):
        """Parse and apply weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P3W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 22)

    def test_days_only(self):
        """Parse and apply days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P3D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 13)

    def test_hours_only(self):
        """Parse and apply hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 8)

    def test_minutes_only(self):
        """Parse and apply minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 15), "PT20M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 35)

    def test_seconds_only(self):
        """Parse and apply seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 15, 10), "PT30S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 15, 40)

    def test_leading_zeros_on_components(self):
        """Leading zeros in components are allowed."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P02Y03M")
        assert result == datetime(2027, 4, 1)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT01H02M03S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3)


class TestComponentCombinations:
    """Test combinations of multiple components."""

    def test_years_and_months(self):
        """Years and months applied together."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_years_months_days(self):
        """Years, months, and days combined."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P1Y2M3D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 18)

    def test_years_months_time(self):
        """Years, months with time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 30), "P1Y2M3D")
        # Time should be preserved
        assert result.hour == 10 and result.minute == 30

    def test_full_duration(self):
        """Full duration with all non-week components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15, 8, 30, 45), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 18, 12, 35, 51)

    def test_days_and_time(self):
        """Days combined with time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10), "P2DT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 3, 13)


class TestFractionalParts:
    """Test parsing and applying fractional components."""

    def test_fractional_seconds_dot_separator(self):
        """Fractional seconds with dot separator."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_seconds_comma_separator(self):
        """Fractional seconds with comma separator."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1,5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_minutes_dot(self):
        """Fractional minutes with dot separator."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT0.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 30)

    def test_fractional_minutes_comma(self):
        """Fractional minutes with comma separator."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT0,5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 30)

    def test_fractional_hours(self):
        """Fractional hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0), "PT1.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 30)

    def test_fractional_days(self):
        """Fractional days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0), "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12)

    def test_fractional_weeks(self):
        """Fractional weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0), "P0.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 4, 12)

    def test_fractional_zero_integer_part(self):
        """Fractional component with zero integer part (e.g., 0.5)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT0.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 500000)

    def test_fractional_multiple_digits(self):
        """Fractional part with multiple digits."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1.123S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 123000)

    def test_fractional_only_component(self):
        """Only the last component can have a fractional part."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5Y2M")

    def test_fractional_on_month_invalid(self):
        """Fractions not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5M")

    def test_fractional_on_year_invalid(self):
        """Fractions not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5Y")

    def test_fractional_on_non_last_component_day(self):
        """Fractional part only on last component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5D2H")

    def test_fractional_missing_integer_part(self):
        """Fractional component requires at least one digit on each side."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT.5S")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1.S")

    def test_multiple_decimal_separators_invalid(self):
        """Multiple decimal separators are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1.2.3S")


class TestMonthYearApplication:
    """Test special month and year arithmetic rules."""

    def test_month_overflow_january_to_february(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 29 (leap year)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_month_overflow_january_to_february_non_leap(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28 (non-leap year)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_month_overflow_march_31_to_february(self):
        """Mar 31 + 11 months = Feb 29 (leap year, day clamped)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "P11M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_months_no_overflow(self):
        """Multiple months without day overflow."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P13M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_year_and_month_together(self):
        """Years and months applied in one step (13 months total)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 29)

    def test_year_and_month_then_day(self):
        """Year and month applied first, then day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M1D")
        # First apply 1 month: 2024-01-31 -> 2024-02-29
        # Then apply 1 day: 2024-02-29 -> 2024-03-01
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_time_preserved_during_month_adjustment(self):
        """Hours, minutes, seconds preserved during month addition."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31, 15, 30, 45), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29, 15, 30, 45)

    def test_leap_year_february_29(self):
        """Feb 29 stays Feb 29 when adding years in leap years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P4Y")
        assert result == datetime(2028, 2, 29)

    def test_leap_year_february_29_to_non_leap(self):
        """Feb 29 becomes Feb 28 when year doesn't have Feb 29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_negative_month_overflow(self):
        """Mar 31 - 1 month = Feb 29 (leap year, day clamped)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_negative_months_cross_year(self):
        """Negative months can cross year boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 15), "-P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 11, 15)


class TestDayWeekApplication:
    """Test week and day arithmetic (exact multiples)."""

    def test_one_week_exact(self):
        """One week is exactly 7 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 8)

    def test_multiple_weeks_exact(self):
        """Multiple weeks are exact multiples of 7 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P3W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 22)

    def test_fractional_week_exact(self):
        """Fractional weeks are exact multiples: P0.5W = 3.5 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0), "P0.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 4, 12)

    def test_one_day_exact(self):
        """One day is exactly 24 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 11, 5)

    def test_multiple_days_exact(self):
        """Multiple days are exact."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 20)

    def test_fractional_day_exact(self):
        """Fractional days are exact: P0.5D = 12 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0), "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12)

    def test_days_cross_month_boundary(self):
        """Days cross month boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 29), "P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 3)

    def test_days_cross_year_boundary(self):
        """Days cross year boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 28), "P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 2)

    def test_negative_weeks(self):
        """Negative weeks subtract exactly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 15), "-P2W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 1)

    def test_negative_days(self):
        """Negative days subtract exactly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 15), "-P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 10)


class TestTimeApplication:
    """Test exact time arithmetic."""

    def test_one_hour_exact(self):
        """One hour is exact."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30), "PT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 11, 30)

    def test_fractional_hour_exact(self):
        """Fractional hours: PT0.5H = 30 minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10), "PT0.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30)

    def test_one_minute_exact(self):
        """One minute is exact."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 15), "PT1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 16)

    def test_fractional_minute_exact(self):
        """Fractional minutes: PT0.5M = 30 seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10), "PT0.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 30)

    def test_one_second_exact(self):
        """One second is exact."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 15, 30), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 15, 31)

    def test_fractional_second_exact(self):
        """Fractional seconds: PT0.5S = 500000 microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10), "PT0.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 500000)

    def test_time_crosses_hour_boundary(self):
        """Time components cross hour/day boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 23, 45), "PT30M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 15)

    def test_time_crosses_day_boundary(self):
        """Time components cross day boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 22), "PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1)

    def test_negative_time_exact(self):
        """Negative time subtracts exactly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30), "-PT1H30M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 9, 0)

    def test_negative_time_crosses_day_boundary(self):
        """Negative time can cross day boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 2, 2), "-PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 23)

    def test_hours_minutes_seconds_combined(self):
        """Hours, minutes, seconds combined."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 20, 30), "PT1H15M45S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 11, 36, 15)


class TestNegativeDurations:
    """Test handling of negative durations."""

    def test_negative_duration_one_day(self):
        """Negative duration with one day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 9)

    def test_negative_duration_months_and_days(self):
        """Negative duration applies months first, then days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        # First back 1 month: 2024-03-01 -> 2024-02-01
        # Then back 1 day: 2024-02-01 -> 2024-01-31
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_negative_duration_month_and_day_clamp(self):
        """Negative month with day subtraction."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M1D")
        # First back 1 month: 2024-03-31 -> 2024-02-29
        # Then back 1 day: 2024-02-29 -> 2024-02-28
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 28)

    def test_negative_duration_plus_sign(self):
        """Plus sign followed by negative duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 10), "+-P1D")
        # Plus sign doesn't change anything, then minus applies
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 9)

    def test_negative_fractional_seconds(self):
        """Negative fractional seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 2), "-PT0.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_negative_weeks(self):
        """Negative weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 15), "-P2W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 1)

    def test_negative_years(self):
        """Negative years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "-P2Y")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 3, 15)


class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and boundary conditions."""

    def test_no_change_zero_duration_invalid(self):
        """P0D is invalid (at least one component required)."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P0D")

    def test_very_large_component(self):
        """Very large component values work."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P999D")
        assert result == datetime(2027, 9, 27)

    def test_datetime_min_value(self):
        """Working with datetime.min."""
        # datetime.min is 0001-01-01
        result = add_duration(datetime(1, 1, 2), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(1, 1, 1)

    def test_datetime_max_value(self):
        """Working with datetime.max."""
        # datetime.max is 9999-12-31
        result = add_duration(datetime(9999, 12, 30), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(9999, 12, 31)

    def test_datetime_max_exceeds_range(self):
        """Adding duration that exceeds datetime.max raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(9999, 12, 31), "P1D")

    def test_datetime_min_exceeds_range(self):
        """Subtracting duration that goes below datetime.min raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(1, 1, 1), "-P1D")

    def test_microsecond_precision_preserved(self):
        """Microsecond precision is preserved."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 123456), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 123456)

    def test_fractional_rounding_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional parts round to nearest microsecond."""
        # PT0.5000005S should round up to 500001 microseconds
        # This tests the rounding mechanism
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000005S")
        # The result should round to nearest microsecond
        assert result.microsecond == 1

    def test_fractional_rounding_down(self):
        """Fractional parts round down when < 0.5 microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000001S")
        # Should round down to 0 microseconds
        assert result.microsecond == 0

    def test_combination_all_components_no_weeks(self):
        """Full duration without weeks."""
        result = add_duration(
            datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 30, 45),
            "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S"
        )
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 18, 14, 35, 51)

    def test_many_months_exceeding_year(self):
        """Many months (more than 12) work correctly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P25M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 1)

    def test_december_add_months_cross_year(self):
        """Adding months from December crosses year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 12, 15), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_february_leap_year_add_subtract(self):
        """Feb 29 behavior in leap years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P365D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_decimal_places(self):
        """Multiple decimal places in fractional component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.123456789S")
        # Should have microsecond precision (6 decimal places)
        assert result.microsecond == 123457  # Rounded to nearest microsecond


class TestRealWorldExamples:
    """Test realistic use cases combining multiple features."""

    def test_add_one_month_to_month_end(self):
        """Add one month to end of month."""
        # This is a common edge case in business logic
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 4, 30), "P1M")

def test_leap_year_to_non_leap():
    """Adding years from leap year Feb 29 to non-leap year."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
    assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)


def test_all_components_maximum():
    """Large values in all components."""
    result = add_duration(
        datetime(2000, 1, 1),
        "P100Y100M100DT100H100M100S"
    )
    # 100 years + 100 months = 108 years 4 months
    # Plus 100 days, 100 hours, 100 minutes, 100 seconds
    expected = datetime(2108, 5, 11, 4, 40, 40)
    assert result == expected


def test_months_exactly_twelve():
    """Adding exactly 12 months."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P12M")
    assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 15)


def test_months_just_under_twelve():
    """Adding 11 months."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P11M")
    assert result == datetime(2025, 12, 15)


def test_months_over_twelve():
    """Adding more than 12 months."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P25M")
    assert result == datetime(2027, 2, 15)


def test_multiple_years():
    """Adding multiple years."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15), "P10Y")
    assert result == datetime(2030, 1, 15)


def test_combined_negative_months_and_days():
    """Negative duration with both months and days."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 15), "-P1M10D")
    # First subtract 1 month: 2024-03-15 -> 2024-02-15
    # Then subtract 10 days: 2024-02-15 -> 2024-02-05
    assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 5)


def test_combined_positive_months_and_days():
    """Positive duration with both months and days."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 20), "P1M20D")
    # First add 1 month: 2024-01-20 -> 2024-02-20
    # Then add 20 days: 2024-02-20 -> 2024-03-11
    assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 11)


def test_month_day_clamping_february():
    """Complex month/day interaction with February."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P2M")
    # 2024-01-31 + 2 months = 2024-03-31 (Feb 31 doesn't exist, skip to March)
    assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 31)


def test_very_large_seconds():
    """Very large number of seconds (should not overflow day calculation)."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT86400S")
    # 86400 seconds = 24 hours = 1 day
    assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0)


def test_very_large_minutes():
    """Very large number of minutes."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1440M")
    # 1440 minutes = 24 hours = 1 day
    assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0)

def test_spec_example_1():
    """Example: 2024-01-31 plus P1M is 2024-02-29."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
    assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)


def test_spec_example_2():
    """Example: 2024-02-29 plus P1Y1M is 2025-03-29."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y1M")
    assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 29)


def test_spec_example_negative_1():
    """Example: 2024-03-31 minus P1M is 2024-02-29."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
    assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)


def test_spec_example_negative_2():
    """Example: 2024-03-01 minus P1M1D is 2024-01-31."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
    # First subtract 1 month: 2024-03-01 -> 2024-02-01
    # Then subtract 1 day: 2024-02-01 -> 2024-01-31
    assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)


def test_spec_example_fractions_half_day():
    """Example: P0.5D is 12 hours."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P0.5D")
    assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0)


def test_spec_example_fractions_half_hour():
    """Example: PT0.5H is 30 minutes."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT0.5H")
    assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 30)


def test_spec_example_fractions_half_week():
    """Example: P0.5W is 3.5 days."""
    result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P0.5W")
    assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 4, 12, 0)
